title: peucedanum polyanthum
intro: Peucedanum polyanthum, commonly known as Chinese Angelica, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Angelica include its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Peucedanum polyanthum include coumarins, sesquiterpenes, and polyacetylenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
